metadata.notes: Uses outputs.addsTag, not transformedState: a boiled potato that gets salted is still boiled, just also salted now — the two coexist, unlike boiled vs. fried which are mutually exclusive states. requiredIngredientCapabilities: isSeasoning, which data/entities/salt.json already declares (added back when salt.json was first written).
metadata.retrySafeNote: retrySafe: true — engine.ts guards addsTag against duplicates ('!instance.tags.includes(...)'), so re-running this after an interruption is a silent no-op, not a double effect.

verification.description: No reliable sensor check for 'properly seasoned' in this vocabulary — taste isn't modeled at all
